Richard Yang · PortfolioIntroduction
Introduction

Hello! I am Richard Yang.

I am an Industrial Engineering student at BINUS University (GPA 3.56/4.00) specializing in Service System Engineering. I help organizations spend less and deliver more by turning complex processes and raw data into clear decisions: what to produce, how to lay out a facility, and where a service loses time or money.

Across five projects I planned production to avoid wasted stock, designed safer and faster factory layouts, and turned data into decisions people can act on. At HIMTRI I was named Best Staff of Research. I am eager to contribute in teams and am interested in Business Analysis, Operations, and Supply Chain roles.

Project portfolio · Human-Integrated SystemHydroCarry · 2025
Human-Integrated System

HydroCarry

Project Researcher / Ergonomics Analyst · 2025

A fire extinguisher is useless if it is too heavy to reach the fire in time. We redesigned it so anyone can move it quickly and safely.

What I did

Added wheels, an adjustable strap, and a better grip sized to the people who use it.

Benefit

Moving it takes less effort, so help arrives faster and users avoid back and shoulder strain.

Proof

Users reported clearly lower fatigue, and hazards were turned into safer operating steps.

Final poster presentation

Project portfolio · Engineering Data AnalysisExam Score Prediction · 2026
Engineering Data Analysis

Exam Score Prediction

Data Analyst · Group project · 2026

Data only helps when it becomes a decision. I turned 20,000 student records into clear answers on what really drives results.

Find

Showed which habits matter most, with study time the strongest driver.

Predict

Built a model that flags at-risk students before exams.

Act

Gave clear recommendations so support goes where it has the most impact.

Key finding

Study time matters most: students who study 6 to 8 hours score almost twice as high as those who study 0 to 2 hours.

Facility Planning & Layout

OneWave Bottle Factory Layout

Facility Layout Designer · Group project · 2026

A messy factory wastes time moving goods around and puts workers at risk. I designed a layout where materials flow one way, faster and safer.

Space

Safety

Separated people, forklifts, and machines, and proposed camera-based monitoring.
